# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture, dependency, API, data, configuration, and business-workflow documents for this assessment.

- [**architecture-diagram.md**](architecture-diagram.md) — Application architecture layers, technologies, and component relationships.
- [**dependency-map.md**](dependency-map.md) — Declared package dependencies, categories, test dependencies, and compatibility risks.
- [**api-service-contracts.md**](api-service-contracts.md) — MVC endpoints, communication patterns, contracts, and request sequence.
- [**data-architecture.md**](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, catalog entity model, data ownership, and persistence.
- [**configuration-inventory.md**](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, profiles, external settings, secrets workflow, and runtime versions.
- [**business-workflows.md**](business-workflows.md) — Catalog domain, primary workflows, business rules, and workflow sequence.
